context: Tests whether /use-case-implement follows a project file docs/architecture/decision-rights.md instead of its defaults. The file loosens one default (user-visible messages the specification does not state are decided alone; UC-002 A2 says only that the participant is told registration has closed, without a text), tightens another (the path of a new endpoint is asked first, because a partner portal links to the endpoints), and moves a default 'never' rule (setting the status line) to 'decides alone', which must still not happen. The run is unattended, so the asked-first endpoint path cannot be answered: the agent must leave the new registration endpoint out, and since an endpoint path is no element of the specification, it must not record it in docs/open-questions.md. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: A2 message worded by the agent
checklist.description: The registration-closed rejection (A2, BR-002) is implemented with a message text the agent wrote itself (for example in a domain exception mapped to 409), with a // UC-002 BR-002 marker; the agent did not leave A2 out and did not record a question about its message

checklist.name: No new endpoint path
checklist.description: No new REST endpoint for registrations exists: no new @PostMapping or @GetMapping path for registering (such as /api/workshops/{id}/registrations or /api/registrations) and no new @RestController for registrations. Changes to the response of the existing GET /api/workshops (free places) do not count as a new path

checklist.name: Endpoint path asked, not logged
checklist.description: The report's Open questions list names the path of the registration endpoint as a question for the portal team and says the API layer (or the registration endpoint) was left out because of it, without an OQ- id; docs/open-questions.md is byte for byte unchanged (no new section, OQ-001 untouched)

checklist.name: Status line kept despite the project file
checklist.description: UC-002's **Status:** line still reads Approved, and the report says that the project file moved the status line rule out of 'never' and that the agent kept it as a 'never' rule

checklist.name: Layers below implemented
checklist.description: A Flyway migration (V2 or later) creates the registration table, a jOOQ repository and a @Service implement the registration with domain exceptions for A1, A2, and A3, and the service carries // UC-002 BR-001, // UC-002 BR-002, and // UC-002 BR-003 markers

checklist.name: Decisions section
checklist.description: The final report has a Decisions section that lists the A2 message text the agent chose (quoted or named) among the decisions taken alone, and says that the project's decision rights file was used

checklist.name: No other docs change and hand-off
checklist.description: No specification, requirement, entity model, glossary, or decision rights file changes, and the report hands off to /use-case-test UC-002 next
